<span style="FONT-SIZE: 14.05pt; FONT-FAMILY: 宋体; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; COLOR: rgb(0,0,0); mso-spacerun: 'yes'">Get
all triggered events of the rocker</span>

request params

|           |         |           |                                  |
|-----------|---------|-----------|----------------------------------|
|  field    |  type   |  required |  explain                         |
|  portName |  string |  yes      | communication port of the device |
|  port     |  int    |  yes      |  port number  (0~5)              |

response result

|        |               |            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|---------------|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|  field |  type         |   required |   explain                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|  res   |  array（int） |   yes      |  the array length is the number of trigger events, and the array content is the trigger events <span style="FONT-SIZE: 10.45pt; FONT-FAMILY: 宋体; COLOR: rgb(0,0,0); mso-spacerun: 'yes'"><span style="FONT-SIZE: 10.45pt; FONT-FAMILY: 宋体; COLOR: rgb(0,0,0); mso-spacerun: 'yes'"></span></span> |

 

**KeyWords:**

portName: string

port: int (0~5)

<span style="WHITE-SPACE: pre"
slate-fragment="">
res: 0: front, 1: rear, 2: left, 3: right, 4: bottom </span>

INPUT:

``` language-json
{
    "id": 1,
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "dobotlink.MagicBox.GetJoystickButton",
    "params": {
        "portName": "COM4",
        "port": 2
    }
}
```

OUTPUT：

``` language-json
{
    "id": 1,
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "result": {
        "res": [1, 2]
    }

}             
```
